method.question: For every original London held key, which retained source polygons contain or touch that cell center?
method.semantics: Center membership in projected source polygons. Polygon edges use even-odd crossings and a separately reported 1e-9 projected-grid-unit boundary tolerance. These are source-center correspondences, not whole-cell geometric contact, legal authority, current applicability, or repair qualification.
method.projection: Pinned src/pixel-grid.js Web Mercator integer grid; GRID_WIDTH=262166. Source coordinates are projected using its projectCell formula; the original key is sampled at (x+0.5,y+0.5).
